The pre-existing keyword is owner-materialized from native membership, not copied from the native package; find-before-intern identity and relocation are executed.
Fixed-capacity sealed package topology and pinned objects; no package mutation API, production symbol registration, moving package scanner or complete bootstrap membership claim.

Two through sixteen admitted packages; at most one directly used package each; no package mutation, import/export/shadow APIs, intern hooks or name/nickname package designators. Symbols have direct home-package pointers, not package-predicate conses.
Table capacities are powers of two from 4 through 256. Names contain at most 4096 code points. Full tables and image exhaustion are checked refusals; no automatic growth or collection.
Owner assigns distinct nonzero binding indices before dynamic binding. Global symbol-value access uses the accepted zero-index fallback. No new production symbol installer is claimed.
INTERN and FIND-SYMBOL are implemented runtime functions reached through function values. This unit does not add source-head rewrites or register their global Lisp names.

Snapshot relocation is an explicit-field owner fixture, not LL14 production image loading. It preserves tagged references and scalar fields; unsupported bases reject before writes. No moving collector scanner for package objects is added.

Malformed runtime arguments use checked refusals, not new Lisp conditions. The trusted image builder supplies well-formed non-overlapping objects; admission is not an arbitrary forged-heap security boundary.
No unshared runtime, cross-Worker mutation, browser qualification, performance or whole bootstrap package membership claim.
